introParagraphs: Getting a product or brand to feel intentional takes more than a good-looking screen — it takes research, systems thinking, and design that holds up as you scale.
Turning that design into a real, working product takes more than writing code — it takes an engineering process that protects performance, accessibility, and quality as you move fast.

That's why we back every engagement with one connected team — designers who've shipped brand systems and product interfaces, and engineers who've shipped production web apps, bridged design-to-dev gaps, and prototyped AI products under real deadlines. Skip the guesswork and the handoff — you'll get the process and craft to launch with confidence.

ctaHeading: Have a brand or product to build?
ctaDescription: We'll help you scope the right starting point — brand, product, web design, or a full build — with a plan built around your users, your product, and your timeline.

faqs.question: How much does a design system cost?
faqs.answer: Design systems typically range from $25K-$100K depending on scope, components needed, and platform complexity. We offer phased approaches to spread investment over time.

faqs.question: How long does a typical brand identity project take?
faqs.answer: A full brand identity — logo, type, color, and guidelines — typically takes 4-8 weeks depending on the number of stakeholders and revision rounds.

faqs.question: Do you design for both web and mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes — we design responsive web experiences and native iOS/Android or cross-platform mobile apps, and can build one design system that covers both.

faqs.question: Can you work within our existing brand guidelines?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We can design within an established brand system, or help evolve it if it's holding your product back.

faqs.question: What tools do you use for design systems?
faqs.answer: Figma is our primary tool — component libraries, auto-layout, and variant systems — paired with documentation your engineering team can build from directly.

faqs.question: Do you provide developer handoff documentation?
faqs.answer: Yes — every project includes handoff specs, redlines, and component documentation so your development team can implement without guesswork.

faqs.question: What tech stack do you build with?
faqs.answer: React and Next.js for the front-end, with flexible back-end and database choices depending on your needs — plus AI-assisted tools like Cursor and v0 for rapid prototyping.

faqs.question: Can you integrate AI features into our existing product?
faqs.answer: Yes — we handle LLM integration (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini), vector databases, and RAG implementation, scoped to fit into your current architecture.

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing maintenance after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes — we offer post-launch support ranging from bug fixes and updates to full ongoing feature development.

faqs.question: Can you work within our existing codebase, or do you require a rewrite?
faqs.answer: In most cases we work within your existing codebase. A rewrite is only recommended when the current architecture genuinely blocks what you're trying to build.

faqs.question: Do you build custom Shopify themes or use existing templates?
faqs.answer: Both — we can customize a proven template for speed and budget, or build a fully custom theme when your brand and conversion goals call for it.

faqs.question: How much does a typical engagement cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on scope — a focused MVP prototype looks very different from a full production build. Book a free consultation and we'll put together a fit-for-purpose quote.
